title: Codex account action: resume mailbox wakes held at a closed account fence (coalesced, acknowledged and post-restart)
outcome: Codex account action: resume mailbox wakes held at a closed account fence (coalesced, acknowledged and post-restart)
acceptance: A mailbox wake (direct, coalesced with a second wake, or rewritten by an acknowledgement) that reaches an idle local Codex session while an account action holds its fence is not lost and returns no error: it stays queued, and when the action ends with the account admitting work it is dispatched exactly once; behavioural tests cover the direct, coalesced and acknowledgement-rewrite cases.
A held mailbox-only queue survives a TermAl restart and is dispatched when the next account action ends (or at boot when no action is pending); a behavioural test drives the restart.
A non-human User dispatch to a fenced idle Codex session answers Queued, never 500, and its prompt is delivered after the action. The candidate receives the standard review pair and full gate.
